install.summary: a living game design document — the game's design, content and world
install.post_install:
game-development installed. Build the world first with the gdd-worldbuild skill, or:
  python3 scripts/game_tool.py new-location --name "<Place>"
Then use gdd-mechanic / gdd-quest / gdd-level to design the game.
install.post_update:
game-development updated. Carry on with:
  python3 scripts/game_tool.py status
Untouched _prompts/ were refreshed; any you tailored were preserved (see the prompts summary above).
